data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for connecting to Bluetooth Low Energy devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BLE central‑role API for scanning, connecting, and communicating with BLE peripherals on Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, and Web. It wraps native platform APIs and exposes streams for device discovery and data exchange.
use_when: You need cross‑platform BLE communication in a Flutter app
You want a zero‑dependency plugin that works on mobile, desktop, and web
avoid_when: You require Bluetooth Classic or peripheral role support
Your project is a for‑profit commercial product without purchasing a commercial license
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, and Web
Zero third‑party dependencies beyond Flutter itself
Active maintenance with recent bug fixes
weaknesses: Commercial license required for for‑profit use
Windows support is provided by a separate package
Only central role; no peripheral capabilities
data.setup_notes: Add Bluetooth permissions to AndroidManifest (BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, etc.) and iOS Info.plist (NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription). On Web, ensure HTTPS and user gesture for scanning. Windows requires flutter_blue_plus_winrt package.
